name: Steve Witkoff
moments: He says Trumpism is defined by an unshakable cult mentality and that Republican voters will keep voting for the party in 2026 and 2028. He says Trump faced prison and bankruptcy in 2024, so he took oligarch money and set up scams, which he says were brought to him by his Jewish fixers Witkoff and Lutnick.
